520	Again, so that after 120 years of Rav Shach there will be someone fit to instruct others to go out
521	and work, that is why I am staying.
522	Because if I go out to work, I won't be a Torah scholar.
523	And if I won't be a Torah scholar, I won't be able to instruct others to go out and work.
524	So that is why he stayed.
525	So Rav Shach, on Purim, a few young men from the yeshiva came to him.
526	They sat with him, words of Torah, and there was joy.
527	Suddenly Rabbi Shlomo Lorincz walked in.
528	Do you remember him?
529	He was a Knesset member, he was also a deputy minister, he had...
530	What?
531	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
532	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
533	He walked in, and the young men immediately understood: Rabbi Lorincz came in, a Knesset member, so they have to
534	vacate his seat. In any case, a person of importance walked in.
535	So they got up to clear the place for him to come in; he came with mishloach manot.
536	Rav Shach signaled to them: sit.
537	He took Rabbi Lorincz to the kitchen.
538	He brought him a different mishloach manot, accompanied him outside, did everything properly.
539	He came back and told them how important he is, how much he brings merit to the many, and how much depends on him.
540	But yeshiva students who sit and learn, their level is greater,
541	and their standing is more important.
542	And he stayed to speak with those young men, to show them that they are more important than that Knesset
543	member.
544	And therefore, the Gemara says in Tractate Megillah, page 16b:
545	Torah study is greater than saving lives. What does it mean that Torah study is greater
546	than saving lives?
547	Ateret Zahav says, Yoreh De'ah, siman 251, subsection 6, Laws of Tzedakah:
548	Say there is now a suicide terrorist, may HaShem have mercy, who wants to enter
549	the mall there, Malha Mall,
550	wants to enter the mall and carry out an attack, and the security guard discovers it, immediately leaps
551	on him, takes him down to the floor, ties his hands. Let's make it a story, okay,
552	okay, and he saved all the people in Malha Mall. They will let him light
553	a torch on Independence Day and he will receive a citizen's, how do you say, some medal
554	of honor. But a yeshiva student, or a person who sits here and learns
555	in the synagogue on Rehov Bo, at that same time, says Ateret Zahav, in heaven he receives a reward much
556	higher than that security guard who saved hundreds of people. You
557	have that, how do you say, the plumber,
558	that plumber, yes, from the plane, I don't remember his name,
559	that plumber who saved the 170 passengers there on the plane.
